sentences.text: James Brolin -LRB- -LSB- ˈbroʊlᵻn -RSB- born July 18 , 1940 -RRB- is an American actor , producer , and director , best known for his roles in film and television , including sitcoms and soap operas .
He is the father of actor Josh Brolin and husband of singer/actress Barbra Streisand .	Barbra Streisand	Barbra Streisand	Josh Brolin	Josh Brolin
Among other awards , Brolin has won two Golden Globes and an Emmy .	Emmy	Emmy Award
He received a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on August 27 , 1998 .	Hollywood Walk of Fame	Hollywood Walk of Fame
